nodes.label: EMS (Environmental Management System)
nodes.rationale: Tracks fuel, electricity, water and paper consumption plus ESWM and GHG compliance for DENR-PENRO Dinagat Islands, in support of ISO 14001:2015.

nodes.label: fully offline LAN deployment
nodes.rationale: No internet dependency and no off-site access, which forces adapter-node over adapter-auto, bans CDN assets and fonts, and rules out OAuth or any third-party login in favour of session-based auth. Roughly 60% of clients are on WiFi, so session handling, form submissions and loading states must fail gracefully and recover rather than assume a stable link.

nodes.label: one role per user, no per-user overrides
nodes.rationale: Roles today are Admin, GSU (which approves other roles' requests), and per-section Encoder/Focal roles. Section-to-role mapping is still to be decided. Scale is under twenty users with five to ten concurrent.

nodes.label: approvers may approve their own submissions
nodes.rationale: Matches actual agency practice for GSU and is deliberate, not an oversight.
